title: Decision: StatusProvider uses impl Future not async-trait
description: listener.rs defines the StatusProvider trait with an associated-future return type (impl Future) rather than using the async-trait macro. This is correct for a per-request hot path: async-trait boxes every future on the heap (Box<dyn Future>), adding an allocation per call. The RPITIT (return-position impl Trait in traits) approach, stabilized in Rust 1.75, gives zero-cost dispatch and removes a proc-macro dependency while keeping the trait object-safe enough for the generic bound T: StatusProvider used at the call site.
